messages:
alex: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to @tess for saving the demo AND reviving the office plant this morning. multitasking legend :tada: :plant:
maya: Seriously, major hero energy. Also the croissants you put out were a life-saver :heart_eyes: :croissant:
sanjay: +1. And tidy debugging on the staging timeout. That fix kept the handoff smooth. :raised_hands:
tess: little things add up, glad it helped! team effort tho — shouts to @sanjay for the quick config rollback idea. :mechanical_arm:
alex: we need a tiny reward. proposing 'mini-hero medal' stickers for the snack shelf. vote with :medal: if you want one for Tess
maya: :medal: (100% yes)
sanjay: :medal:
kudos-bot: recorded award: mini-hero recipient: tess points: 3 reason: "demo rescue + plant CPR"
alex: love the automated receipts. can we also emoji-badge this in the kudos spreadsheet? :eyes:
kudos-bot: added entry to #kudos-log: "tess — demo + office plant rescue (3)". link: https://docs.example.com/kudos-log
maya: tiny celebration at 3pm? quick coffee + sticker ceremony? :coffee: :tada:
tess: i'll bring stickers and my terrible trophy speech. fair warning. :grin:
sanjay: i'll bring the coffee. anyone want oat/regular/decaf?
alex: regular + oat please. thanks again @tess, this made the whole day smoother. :sparkles:
